_comments.psi_note: psi_stage='near_thresh' (f=0.85 × Lambda), heterogeneous_wear=True. GPU psi_0 ≈ 6242.4/7344, CPU psi_0 ≈ 2313.7/2722. For at_thresh/over_thresh stages, PM fires at or near slot 0; verify N_min feasibility for large fleets with tight time limits.
_comments.references: GPU params: Bashir et al. (2021) EuroSys; Fadaeefath Abadi et al. (2025) IEEE TDSC. CPU params: Weng et al. (2022) USENIX ATC. Thermal D: O'Brien et al. (2020) ASPLOS. Rack topology: Sinai et al. (2023) ASPLOS.
_comments.resource_split_note: Resource split into CPU and memory. C_cpu=original normalized capacity; C_mem=1.0. theta_cpu/theta_mem duplicate the reservation. CPU load drives power/heat/wear/noise; memory is packing-only.
_comments.maintenance_seed_note: 8 servers ([0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56]) start the horizon with psi_0 >= Lambda (110% of threshold), which makes preventive maintenance admissible via the PM-trigger constraint and drives the model to schedule maintenance windows for them.

acoustics.zones_note: Acoustic zones coincide with failure domains F (rack columns).
